spec.name: B0_random
spec.doc: Uniform random order within each proof. The floor.
spec.sort_semantics: The function returns a tuple of ASCENDING lexicographic sort keys, one array per key, aligned to the candidate array `base`. Candidates are ordered within each proof by np.lexsort over those keys. Lower key value = better rank. A ranking never deletes: anything it dislikes it places last.
